en.title: About Devfolio
en.lead: Devfolio is an open portfolio starter from ITwerf for GitHub Pages.
intro: This generic repo is meant to be forked or downloaded and made your own: change the config, swap in your projects and posts, and deploy from the repo root.
ITwerf is the organisation behind Devfolio - a community focused on collaboration, education, and supporting people in tech who do not always have it easy.
closing: Edit config/site.json and the files under content/, then push to GitHub Pages (Deploy from branch, main, root).
For the full ITwerf story, visit https://itwerf.github.io/about.html
